shortDescription: India's Akasa Air is in talks to order more than 200 Boeing NYSE:BA 737 MAX jets, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.The new purchase would keep its fleet growing beyond 2032, the report added.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
